source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: If the bearer's unit disembarked this turn from a **TRANSPORT**, each time it is picked to shoot in your Shooting phase its ranged weapons gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** until the phase ends. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR** or **GRAVIS** model may take it.

effects.trigger: whenever the bearer's unit is chosen to shoot
effects.condition: the unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn
effects.appliesTo: ranged weapons of models in the bearer's unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Armoured Speartip Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
